To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
POH and methyl jasmonates sensitize cancer cells, MDA-MB435 and MDA-231, to cisplatin by inducing apoptosis and blocking cells in G0/G1.
POH and methyl jasmonates sensitizes breast cancer cells to cisplatins.
POH and methyl jasmonates sensitize MDA-MB 435 and MDA- MB-231 cells to cisplatinum.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a new chemotherapeutic regimen for breast cancer that will be effective and less toxic.
the identification of new drug candidates and combination therapy for breast cancer treatment.
the identification of new drug combinations that may be used to enhance the efficacy of current chemotherapeutic agents and reduce the dose of these agents to reduce side effects in cancer therapy.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the combination of POH, and MJ with cisplatin is an effective treatment for breast cancer cells.
POH and/or MJ can sensitize breast cancer cells to cis-platin treatment and this combination treatment can be a good alternative for breast cancer treatment.
the combination treatment with POH, MJ and cisplatin could be a promising alternative to the current chemotherapeutic treatment of breast cancer.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the combination of three drugs (POH, MJ, cisplatin) could be a promising therapeutic strategy for breast cancer treatment.
POH and/or MJ could be used as adjuvant therapy with cisplatin.
combination of POH and cisplatin, MJ and cisplatin and POH, MJ and cisplatins were effective in breast cancer cells, and the most effective schedule was POH, MJ followed by cisplatin.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the combination of three drugs is better than two drugs alone and that the order of drug exposure is important.
POH and/or MJ could be a promising alternative treatment option for breast cancer patients.
POH and jasmonate can be used in combination with cisplatin as a novel treatment option for breast cancer.
